title: Bun Deployment
content:
Gravito applications are engineered for friction-less delivery across the modern cloud. Powered by the **Bun native runtime**, deployment becomes a high-speed execution of your business logic on the edge.

Deployment Matrix

Choose the optimal execution path for your workload. Gravito supports everything from high-density containers to zero-cold-start edge functions.

L4_CONTAINERS

Optimized Docker images using Bun-slim. High-density execution for Cloud Run and K8s environments.

EDGE_FUNCTIONS

Millisecond cold starts on Cloudflare and Vercel. Global distribution with zero infrastructure overhead.

STATIC_SSG

Pre-rendered HTML for maximum SEO and performance. Deploy to any static provider with zero-latency delivery.

Route A: Docker Containerization

Our recommended path for full-stack PlanetCore applications. The Bun-native image provides a lean, high-security environment with minimal footprint.

# Multi-stage optimized Dockerfile
FROM oven/bun:latest as builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN bun install --frozen-lockfile
RUN bun run build

FROM oven/bun:slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /app .
ENV NODE_ENV=production
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["bun", "run", "src/server/index.ts"]

Route B: Static Site Generation (SSG)

Perfect for marketing sites and documentation. Photon's SSG engine pre-renders every route into high-performance static fragments.

# Execution Protocol
bun run build:static

# Deploy /dist-static to:
# - Cloudflare Pages (Edge Native)
# - Google Cloud Hosting
# - Vercel / Netlify

Production Setup Matrix

Configuring your environment for mission-critical execution.

Environment Variables

  • NODE_ENV=production
  • DATABASE_URL=...
  • JWT_SECRET=...
  • STRIPE_SECRET=...

Health Protocols

  • /health (Liveliness)
  • /ready (Readiness)
  • process.uptime()
  • DB.raw('SELECT 1')

Platform Specific Guides

Google Cloud Run

# Submitting via Cloud Build
gcloud builds submit --tag gcr.io/PROJECT/app

# Deploying Managed Instance
gcloud run deploy app --image gcr.io/PROJECT/app --region us-central1

Edge Deployment (Vercel/Cloudflare)

# Vercel native deployment
vercel --prod

# Fly.io Global Edge
fly deploy

// OPS_SPEC: MULTI_CORE_CLUSTERING

In multi-core environments, use the `--workers auto` flag with Bun to enable native OS-level request clustering across all available CPU cores without complex master/worker logic.

Monitoring Hierarchy

  • Structured JSON Logging: Native integration with Cloud Logging and Datadog.
  • Tracing: OpenTelemetry support for complex distributed architectures.
  • Error Tracking: First-class Sentry support via the OrbitGuard module.

**Architect's Insight:** Deployment is the moment of truth. We designed the Gravito engine to be runtime-agnostic and container-first. Whether you're running on a single Raspberry Pi or a global serverless mesh, the core performance profile remains consistent.
